input.quote: Commencing six (6) months prior to the expiration of the Term of this Agreement, or upon any termination of this Agreement for any reason, M&I shall provide Customer, at Customer's expense, all necessary assistance to allow the Services to continue without interruption or adverse affect to Customer and to facilitate the orderly transition of Services to Customer or its designee ("Termination Assistance").
input.rationale: Section 11.4 is a genuine transition clause: it is triggered six months before expiry or on any termination for any reason, obliges M&I to give all necessary assistance and to build a transition plan on our schedule, and allows continued Services for up to six months at contract rates, with charges at M&I's then-current rates. That satisfies the trigger, duration and rate elements at the preferred level. However, no provision anywhere requires M&I to return or export Customer Data on exit: § 17.1 only confirms our ownership, § 17.5 only imposes security safeguards, and the § 23 source-code licence expires with the Term. The absence of any data-return mechanic fails the fallback (export within 30 days) and sits in walk-away territory ("no data return"). We therefore insert a short § 11.5 requiring return within 30 days in a machine-readable format plus certified deletion, anchored so it does not contradict the retained six-month Termination Assistance mechanic. The 100-day election notice and the at-our-expense basis in § 11.4 are noted but not redlined.

proposal.summary: Insert a data return, format and deletion-certification mechanic after § 11.4.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 11.4 gives us transition assistance at M&I's then-current rates, but nothing requires M&I to give our data back or to delete it afterwards. We have added a short exit mechanic requiring return of all Customer Data within 30 days in a machine-readable format and written certification of deletion once Termination Assistance is complete; if helpful we can drop the certification and keep only the 30-day export.

ops.text: Data Return and Deletion. Within thirty (30) days after the expiration or termination of this Agreement, M&I shall return all Customer Data to Customer in a commonly used, machine-readable format, and shall, following completion of any Termination Assistance, delete all Customer Data from its systems and certify such deletion to Customer in writing.
